repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate introduced an extra absolute-value calculation (lines 4-7) not present in the IR, causing a false positive trigger when the temperature dropped by 3 degrees. The IR only triggers if the difference is positive and >= 3.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute-value logic. The script now strictly follows the IR's arithmetic direction ($t2 - $t1) and condition ($t2 - $t1 >= 3).
